words.enDefinition: a menu listing food available to order and take away

examples.en: The café has a takeout menu with sandwiches that are ready before my afternoon lab.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的「外带菜单」上有三明治，能在我下午的实验课前做好。

examples.en: I checked the takeout menu because we were eating on the lawn after practice.
examples.zh: 训练后我们要在草坪上吃饭，所以我看了看「外带菜单」。

words.enDefinition: a food order the customer collects from the restaurant

examples.en: I placed a pickup order so I could grab dinner after my evening lecture.
examples.zh: 我下了个「自提订单」，晚上上完课就能去拿晚饭。

examples.en: My pickup order was waiting on the shelf beside two bags for delivery drivers.
examples.zh: 我的「自提订单」放在架子上，旁边有两袋等骑手取的餐。

words.enDefinition: request that a restaurant send the food to your address

examples.en: We decided to order for delivery because nobody wanted to cycle across campus in the rain.
examples.zh: 谁也不想冒雨骑车穿过校园，所以我们决定「点餐叫外送」。

examples.en: You can order for delivery from this café even when its seating area is closed.
examples.zh: 即使堂食座位区关闭了，你也能在这家咖啡馆「点餐叫外送」。

collocations: order for delivery through an app

words.enDefinition: a shelf where restaurants leave completed orders for collection

examples.en: The staff put my bag on the pickup shelf with my name facing outwards.
examples.zh: 店员把我的餐袋放上「自助取餐架」，我的名字贴在朝外的一面。

examples.en: I checked the pickup shelf first because the counter was busy during the lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休时柜台挺忙，我先去看了「自助取餐架」。

collocations: leave an order on the pickup shelf

words.enDefinition: a staffed counter where customers collect food orders

examples.en: I went to the pickup counter to get the noodles I'd ordered during my seminar break.
examples.zh: 我去「取餐柜台」拿了研讨课课间点的面条。

examples.en: The pickup counter is next to the entrance where the bike racks are.
examples.zh: 「取餐柜台」就在有自行车架的那个入口旁边。

words.enDefinition: a slip listing the items to prepare or hand over

examples.en: The order ticket showed two sandwiches, so the staff checked the bag a second time.
examples.zh: 「餐厅点单小票」上写着两份三明治，所以店员又检查了一遍餐袋。

examples.en: The café taped the order ticket to the bag before placing it on the shelf.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆先把「餐厅点单小票」贴在餐袋上，再把餐袋放到架子上。

words.zhGloss: 我的订单登记在某人名下
words.enDefinition: introduces the name used to identify your food order
acceptedZhAnswers: 我的订单登记在某人名下

examples.en: My order is under the name Chen, and I ordered the soup and two sandwiches.
examples.zh: 「我用陈这个姓下的单」，点了汤和两份三明治。

examples.en: My order is under Maya's name because she placed it for all of us.
examples.zh: 「我的单登记在玛雅名下」，因为是她帮我们大家点的餐。

collocations: my order is under my surname
my order is under my friend's name
my order is under the name I gave online

words.expression: I'm here to pick up my order
words.lemma: i'm here to pick up my order
words.enDefinition: tells restaurant staff you have come to collect your order
acceptedEnVariants: I'm here to pick up my order

examples.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up my order from the app for two rice bowls.
examples.zh: 你好，「我是来取餐的」，在应用里点了两份盖饭。

examples.en: I'm here to pick up my order, but I may be a few minutes early.
examples.zh: 「我是来取餐的」，不过可能早到了几分钟。

collocations: hello, I'm here to pick up my order
I'm here to pick up my order from earlier
I'm here to pick up my order for lunch

words.enDefinition: place a food order before you arrive or want it ready

examples.en: I like to order ahead when I only have half an hour between lectures.
examples.zh: 如果两节课之间只有半小时，我喜欢「提前点餐」。

examples.en: We decided to order ahead so we wouldn't spend our study break waiting for food.
examples.zh: 我们决定「提前点餐」，免得学习间歇都花在等饭上。

words.enDefinition: a food delivery arranged for a chosen future time

examples.en: I booked a scheduled meal delivery for after the last rehearsal of the evening.
examples.zh: 我预约了「时段送餐」，让外卖在晚上最后一次排练后送到。

examples.en: Our group used scheduled meal delivery so the food would arrive when everyone was free.
examples.zh: 我们小组用了「预约时段送餐」，这样大家都有空时餐才能送到。

words.expression: how much longer will it be
words.lemma: how much longer will it be
words.enDefinition: asks how much more time something will take
acceptedEnVariants: how much longer will it be

examples.en: Excuse me, how much longer will it be for the two takeaway noodle bowls?
examples.zh: 你好，两碗外带面「还要等多久」？

examples.en: How much longer will it be if I add another sandwich to the order?
examples.zh: 如果再加一份三明治，「还要等多久」？

collocations: roughly, how much longer will it be?
how much longer will it be for my order?
sorry, how much longer will it be?

words.enDefinition: the time a meal is expected to be ready for collection

examples.en: The estimated pickup time changed while I was walking over from the sports centre.
examples.zh: 我从体育中心走过去时，「预计取餐时间」变了。

examples.en: I checked the estimated pickup time before deciding whether I could collect the order myself.
examples.zh: 我先看了「预计取餐时间」，再决定自己能不能过去拿。

words.expression: I'm on my way to pick it up
words.lemma: i'm on my way to pick it up
words.enDefinition: says you are travelling to collect the order now
acceptedEnVariants: I'm on my way to pick it up

examples.en: I'm on my way to pick it up and should be there before seven.
examples.zh: 「我正在过去拿餐」，应该七点前能到。

examples.en: I'm on my way to pick it up, but the bus is running late.
examples.zh: 「我正在过去拿餐」，不过公交晚点了。

collocations: I'm on my way to pick it up now
I'm on my way to pick it up from campus
just to let you know, I'm on my way to pick it up

words.enDefinition: a food order placed by speaking to a restaurant by phone

examples.en: I placed a phone order because the café's full lunch menu wasn't listed online.
examples.zh: 网上没有咖啡馆完整的午餐菜单，我就用「电话点餐」了。

examples.en: The staff checked my phone order against the name I had given them earlier.
examples.zh: 店员用我之前留的名字核对了「电话点餐订单」。

words.enDefinition: a special offer available only for food taken off the premises

examples.en: The café had a takeout-only special for students leaving campus late after evening classes.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有「仅供外带的特惠餐」，方便上完夜课才离校的学生。

examples.en: We chose the takeout-only special because we were having dinner in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们选了「仅供外带的特惠餐」，因为要在共用厨房吃晚饭。

words.enDefinition: the set of locations a restaurant or service delivers to

examples.en: I checked the delivery area after moving to a different residence across the river.
examples.zh: 搬到河对岸另一栋宿舍后，我查了「送餐范围」。

examples.en: The café's delivery area includes the main campus but stops before our sports fields.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的「送餐范围」包括主校区，到我们的运动场之前就结束了。

words.enDefinition: an app used to order meals for delivery

examples.en: I opened the food delivery app to see which kitchens were still serving dinner.
examples.zh: 我打开「外卖应用」，看看还有哪些店在供应晚饭。

examples.en: We used a food delivery app because nobody at the rehearsal had time to cook.
examples.zh: 排练的人都没时间做饭，所以我们用了「外卖应用」。

collocations: order through a food delivery app

words.enDefinition: place a food order with the restaurant itself

examples.en: We chose to order directly from the restaurant because we knew its phone number.
examples.zh: 我们知道这家店的电话号码，所以选择「直接向餐厅点餐」。

examples.en: I can order directly from the restaurant if you tell me which dishes you want.
examples.zh: 你告诉我想吃哪些菜，我可以「直接向餐厅点餐」。

collocations: choose to order directly from the restaurant
call to order directly from the restaurant
order directly from the restaurant for pickup

words.enDefinition: one order that combines food choices from several people

examples.en: Our group order let everyone choose a different lunch from the same café menu.
examples.zh: 我们用「多人合点订单」，每个人都能从同一家咖啡馆的菜单上选不同的午饭。

examples.en: I started a group order for my project team before the afternoon presentation rehearsal.
examples.zh: 下午排练汇报前，我给项目组开了个「多人合点订单」。

words.enDefinition: delivery handled by a separate service on a restaurant's behalf

examples.en: This kitchen uses third-party delivery on weekends when its own driver is off work.
examples.zh: 这家店自己的司机周末不上班，所以周末用「第三方送餐」。

examples.en: I asked who handled address changes because the café relies on third-party delivery for lunch.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆午餐依靠「第三方送餐」，所以我问了谁负责处理地址变更。

words.enDefinition: a person who brings a food order to the customer

examples.en: I met the delivery courier by the main gate because my residence has two entrances.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍有两个入口，所以我在正门和「外卖配送员」碰面。

examples.en: The delivery courier called when the café had two bags with the same name.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有两个写着同一个名字的餐袋，「外卖配送员」打来了电话。

collocations: hand an order to the delivery courier

words.enDefinition: a food order placed in person without ordering ahead

examples.en: I placed a walk-in order after passing the café on my way from class.
examples.zh: 下课路上经过咖啡馆时，我「到店当场点了单」。

examples.en: The staff had nearly finished my walk-in order by the time my friend arrived.
examples.zh: 我朋友到的时候，店员已经快做好了我「到店当场点的单」。

words.enDefinition: says the ordering system does not recognize your address

examples.en: It can't find my address when I type the name of my residence.
examples.zh: 我输入宿舍名字时，「系统找不到我的地址」。

examples.en: It can't find my address, so I'm checking what postcode the university uses.
examples.zh: 「系统找不到我的地址」，所以我在查学校用的是哪个邮编。

collocations: it can't find my address in the app
it can't find my address on campus
for some reason, it can't find my address

words.enDefinition: the latest time a restaurant will hand over a prepared order

examples.en: I checked the last pickup time before offering to collect dinner after band practice.
examples.zh: 提出乐队排练后去拿晚饭前，我查了「最晚取餐时间」。

examples.en: The last pickup time is earlier during the break, even on Friday evenings.
examples.zh: 放假期间「最晚取餐时间」提前了，连周五晚上也一样。

collocations: ask about the last pickup time
make it before the last pickup time

words.enDefinition: the line of people waiting to collect food orders

examples.en: The pickup queue reached the door when two lectures finished at the same time.
examples.zh: 两节课同时结束时，「取餐队伍」一直排到了门口。

examples.en: There were two lines, and the pickup queue was moving faster than the ordering line.
examples.zh: 那里排了两条队，「取餐队伍」比点餐队伍走得快。

words.enDefinition: the busy period when many people order dinner at once

examples.en: I ordered before the dinner rush so I could eat in time for choir practice.
examples.zh: 我赶在「晚餐高峰」前点了餐，这样能在合唱排练前吃上。

examples.en: The café stopped taking new orders for a few minutes during the dinner rush.
examples.zh: 「晚餐高峰」时，咖啡馆有几分钟暂停接新单。

words.enDefinition: a kitchen preparing food exclusively for delivery orders

examples.en: I couldn't collect the order myself because it came from a delivery-only kitchen off campus.
examples.zh: 餐是校外「只接外送单的厨房」做的，我不能自己去取。

examples.en: The delivery-only kitchen listed its food online so students could order from their rooms.
examples.zh: 这家「只接外送单的厨房」在线上列了餐品，学生可以在房间里下单。

words.expression: hold the order at the counter
words.lemma: hold the order at the counter
words.zhGloss: 把餐留在柜台等我来拿
words.enDefinition: keep prepared food at the counter until the customer arrives
acceptedZhAnswers: 把餐留在柜台等我来拿
acceptedEnVariants: hold the order at the counter

examples.en: Could you hold the order at the counter until I get there after class?
examples.zh: 能「把餐留在柜台等我来拿」吗？我下课后就到。

examples.en: The staff agreed to hold the order at the counter while I finished my lab.
examples.zh: 我上完实验课前，店员同意「把餐留在柜台等我来拿」。

collocations: please hold the order at the counter
ask them to hold the order at the counter
hold the order at the counter until I arrive

words.expression: it won't let me select pickup
words.lemma: it won't let me select pickup
words.enDefinition: reports that the ordering system will not allow pickup
acceptedEnVariants: it won't let me select pickup

examples.en: It won't let me select pickup, but I'm already walking past the café after class.
examples.zh: 「系统不让我选自提」，可我下课后正好会经过咖啡馆。

examples.en: It won't let me select pickup for the soup, even though the café is open.
examples.zh: 点这份汤时「系统不让我选自提」，可咖啡馆明明还开着。

collocations: it won't let me select pickup today
it won't let me select pickup for this order
for some reason, it won't let me select pickup

words.enDefinition: one portion of food ordered to go with a main dish

examples.en: I ordered a side of fries to share with my flatmate after our lecture.
examples.zh: 下课后我点了「一份薯条」作配菜，和室友分着吃。

examples.en: Could I get a side of rice with the curry in the same bag?
examples.zh: 咖喱能配「一份米饭」吗？放同一个袋子里就好。

words.enDefinition: order an additional dish to go with a main item

examples.en: I decided to add a side because we were sharing one sandwich after rehearsal.
examples.zh: 排练结束后我们要分吃一份三明治，我就决定「加点一份配菜」。

examples.en: Can I still add a side if the kitchen hasn't started our order yet?
examples.zh: 如果后厨还没开始做我们的餐，我还能「加点一份配菜」吗？

collocations: add a side to the order
add a side for a small charge

words.enDefinition: an additional ingredient added on top of a dish

examples.en: I chose an extra topping for my pizza because two of us were sharing it.
examples.zh: 两个人要分吃这份披萨，所以我给它「加了一份配料」。

examples.en: The menu charged for each extra topping, so I only added mushrooms this time.
examples.zh: 菜单上每「加一份配料」都要钱，所以这次我只加了蘑菇。

words.enDefinition: a pizza with different toppings on each of its two halves

examples.en: We ordered a half-and-half pizza because my roommate wanted mushrooms and I wanted peppers.
examples.zh: 我们点了「双拼披萨」，因为室友想吃蘑菇，我想吃甜椒。

examples.en: The shop labeled both sides of the half-and-half pizza on the outside of the box.
examples.zh: 店家在盒子外面标明了「双拼披萨」每一半是什么口味。

words.enDefinition: the outer edge of a pizza with filling inside it

examples.en: We chose stuffed crust for the pizza we shared after our project meeting.
examples.zh: 项目会结束后，我们分吃了一张披萨，选的是「夹馅饼边」。

examples.en: The stuffed crust had cheese inside, which the menu listed separately from the toppings.
examples.zh: 「夹馅饼边」里面有芝士，菜单把它和披萨表面的配料分开列了。

words.enDefinition: a pizza base rolled or stretched so it stays thin

examples.en: I chose thin crust because we were ordering pizza to share before the concert.
examples.zh: 我们点披萨在音乐会前分着吃，所以我选了「薄饼底」。

examples.en: The thin crust stayed crisp on my first slice even after the walk home.
examples.zh: 走回家后，我吃的第一片还是有脆脆的「薄饼底」。

words.enDefinition: a set of food items intended to feed several people

examples.en: We ordered a family meal to share while working on the presentation in our kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们在厨房里一起做演示稿时，点了份「多人家庭套餐」分着吃。

examples.en: The family meal included rice and three mains, so everyone had something they liked.
examples.zh: 「多人家庭套餐」有米饭和三道主菜，每个人都能选到爱吃的。

words.enDefinition: an individual lunch prepared and packed in a box

examples.en: I picked up a boxed lunch before getting on the bus for our field trip.
examples.zh: 坐上实地考察的车之前，我取了份「盒装午餐」。

examples.en: The café made each boxed lunch separately and stuck the student's name on top.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆分开做每份「盒装午餐」，并把学生的名字贴在盒盖上。

words.enDefinition: asks the restaurant to leave utensils out of the order

examples.en: I wrote 'No cutlery, please' because we were eating in my flat's kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们要在我住处的厨房吃，所以我备注了「请不用放餐具」。

examples.en: I said 'No cutlery, please' when I collected the noodles at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台拿面条时，我说了声「请不用放餐具」。

collocations: a note saying no cutlery, please
no cutlery, please, for this order

words.enDefinition: forks, knives, or spoons intended to be used once

examples.en: The café included disposable cutlery because we'd said we were eating on the lawn.
examples.zh: 我们说要在草坪上吃，咖啡馆就放了「一次性餐具」。

examples.en: I asked for disposable cutlery after realizing there were no forks in the studio.
examples.zh: 我发现工作室没有叉子，就要了些「一次性餐具」。

words.enDefinition: a small piece of paper used to wipe your mouth or hands

examples.en: I asked for a paper napkin when I saw the sauce dripping from the sandwich.
examples.zh: 看到三明治的酱汁往下滴，我要了一张「纸餐巾」。

examples.en: There was a paper napkin tucked beside the fork at the bottom of the bag.
examples.zh: 餐袋底部的叉子旁边塞着一张「纸餐巾」。

words.enDefinition: a small sealed packet containing seasoning or a sauce

examples.en: I found a condiment packet at the bottom of the bag after eating the fries.
examples.zh: 吃完薯条后，我在袋子底下发现了一包「袋装调味料」。

examples.en: The staff added a condiment packet to each boxed lunch before sealing the bag.
examples.zh: 封袋之前，店员给每份盒装午餐加了一包「袋装调味料」。

words.enDefinition: a small container used to hold a portion of sauce

examples.en: The sauce cup had a lid, so I could carry it back to my flat.
examples.zh: 「小酱汁杯」有盖子，我就能把它带回公寓。

examples.en: I opened the sauce cup over my plate before dipping the dumplings in it.
examples.zh: 我在盘子上方打开「小酱汁杯」，然后拿饺子蘸着吃。

collocations: a sauce cup with a lid

words.enDefinition: a container used to carry food away from a restaurant

examples.en: The café put my pasta in a takeout container for the walk back to campus.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把意面装进「外带餐盒」，方便我走回学校时带着。

examples.en: I opened the takeout container over a plate because the noodles were covered in sauce.
examples.zh: 面条裹满了酱汁，我就把「外带餐盒」放在盘子上方打开。

collocations: put food in a takeout container

words.enDefinition: a covering designed to stop liquid spilling from a container

examples.en: I asked for a spill-proof lid on the coffee because I was catching a bus.
examples.zh: 我得赶公交，就请店员给咖啡加个「防洒杯盖」。

examples.en: The soup arrived in a pot with a spill-proof lid and a spoon beside it.
examples.zh: 送来的汤装在有「防洒盖」的罐子里，旁边还放了个勺子。

collocations: a cup with a spill-proof lid

words.enDefinition: a tray or holder for carrying several drink cups together

examples.en: I asked for a drink carrier because I had to carry four coffees downstairs.
examples.zh: 我得把四杯咖啡拿下楼，就要了个「饮料杯托」。

examples.en: The drink carrier kept the cups together while my friend opened the door to our residence.
examples.zh: 我朋友开宿舍门时，「饮料杯托」把几个杯子稳稳托在一起。

words.enDefinition: a lined bag designed to keep food warm or cold during delivery

examples.en: The courier placed both meals in an insulated delivery bag before leaving the café.
examples.zh: 配送员把两份餐都放进「保温送餐袋」，然后离开了咖啡馆。

examples.en: I saw the insulated delivery bag first when the driver arrived at the main gate.
examples.zh: 配送员到正门时，我最先看到的是「保温送餐袋」。

collocations: put an order in an insulated delivery bag

words.enDefinition: ask for one item to be packaged on its own

examples.en: Could you pack that separately so my roommate can take her dessert to the library?
examples.zh: 能「把那样东西单独装」吗？我室友好把她的甜点带去图书馆。

examples.en: Please pack that separately because my friend is picking up her meal after rehearsal.
examples.zh: 「请把那样东西单独装」，我朋友排练后才来拿她的餐。

collocations: ask the staff to pack that separately

words.enDefinition: put something in one bag and then place it inside another

examples.en: Could you double-bag the soup containers for the long walk back to my residence?
examples.zh: 我要走很远才能回宿舍，能给装汤的盒子「套上两层袋子」吗？

examples.en: The staff offered to double-bag my order because the bottom of the bag felt damp.
examples.zh: 店员摸到袋底有点潮，就提出给我的餐「套上两层袋子」。

words.enDefinition: a flat box used to carry a pizza

examples.en: I carried the pizza box flat while my flatmate held the door for me.
examples.zh: 室友帮我拉住门时，我把「披萨盒」平端着走。

examples.en: We opened the pizza box on the table as soon as our group arrived.
examples.zh: 我们小组一到，就在桌上打开了「披萨盒」。

words.enDefinition: specifies that unavailable items should not be replaced with alternatives

examples.en: I selected no substitutions because our lunch group had already agreed on the menu.
examples.zh: 我们午餐小组已经商量好吃什么，所以我选了「不接受替换」。

examples.en: The order note said no substitutions, so the café called when the sandwich sold out.
examples.zh: 备注写着「不接受替换」，所以三明治卖完后咖啡馆打了电话。

words.enDefinition: not offered through the delivery option

examples.en: The soup was unavailable for delivery, so we picked it up after our seminar.
examples.zh: 汤「不提供外送」，所以研讨课结束后，我们自己去取了。

examples.en: A few desserts showed as unavailable for delivery after the café changed its evening menu.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆换了晚间菜单后，有几款甜点显示「不提供外送」。

words.enDefinition: put identifying labels on the containers holding each person's food

examples.en: Could you label the boxes with our names so we can hand them out faster?
examples.zh: 能「给餐盒贴上每个人名字的标签」吗？这样我们能发得快些。

examples.en: The café offered to label the boxes before stacking them in the delivery bag.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆提出先「给餐盒贴标签」，再叠放到送餐袋里。

collocations: ask them to label the boxes

words.enDefinition: a band around a cup that makes it easier to hold

examples.en: I asked for a cup sleeve on my coffee before walking back to the library.
examples.zh: 走回图书馆前，我请店员给我的咖啡加一个「杯套」。

examples.en: The cup sleeve slipped off while I was getting my student card out.
examples.zh: 我掏学生证时，「杯套」滑了下来。

collocations: put a cup sleeve on a drink

words.enDefinition: an extra food container available if one is needed

examples.en: I asked for a spare container so we could divide the noodles into two portions.
examples.zh: 我要了个「备用空餐盒」，这样可以把面条分成两份。

examples.en: The shop put a spare container in the bottom of the bag with our order.
examples.zh: 店家给我们的订单袋底还放了一个「备用空餐盒」。

words.enDefinition: sauce for dipping pieces of food before eating them

examples.en: The restaurant let me choose a dipping sauce for the dumplings at no extra cost.
examples.zh: 餐厅让我给饺子选一份「蘸料」，不用额外付费。

examples.en: We opened the dipping sauce after setting the takeaway boxes on the dorm kitchen table.
examples.zh: 把外卖盒放到宿舍厨房的桌上后，我们才打开「蘸料」。

words.enDefinition: a soft drink served from a dispenser into a cup

examples.en: I ordered a fountain drink with my sandwich and took both back to the studio.
examples.zh: 我点三明治时配了一杯「饮料机现接的饮料」，都带回了工作室。

examples.en: The fountain drink came in a cup with a lid and a wrapped straw.
examples.zh: 「饮料机现接的饮料」装在有盖杯里，还配了单独包装的吸管。

words.enDefinition: a drinking straw enclosed in its own small wrapper

examples.en: The café put a wrapped straw in the bag beside my iced tea.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把一根「单独包好的吸管」放进袋子里，就在我的冰茶旁边。

examples.en: I found the wrapped straw under the napkins after bringing lunch back to campus.
examples.zh: 我把午饭带回学校后，在餐巾纸下面找到了那根「单独包好的吸管」。

words.enDefinition: a food box with small openings that let steam escape

examples.en: The café packed the fries in a vented box for the walk back to campus.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆把薯条装在「带透气孔的餐盒」里，方便我走回学校时拿着。

examples.en: The vented box let out steam while I waited by the pickup shelf.
examples.zh: 我在取餐架旁等时，蒸汽从「带透气孔的餐盒」冒了出来。

collocations: pack fries in a vented box
a vented box for hot food

words.enDefinition: a takeout bag with its opening closed and fastened

examples.en: The courier handed me a sealed takeout bag with the receipt stapled to the top.
examples.zh: 配送员递给我一个「封好的外卖袋」，小票订在袋口上。

examples.en: I left the sealed takeout bag on the table until my project partner got back.
examples.zh: 在项目搭档回来前，我把「封好的外卖袋」放在了桌上。

collocations: hand over a sealed takeout bag

words.enDefinition: paper that resists grease and is used to wrap food

examples.en: The café wrapped my toasted sandwich in greaseproof paper before putting it in the bag.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆先用「防油纸」包好我的烤三明治，再放进袋子。

examples.en: I unfolded the greaseproof paper and used it as a plate at the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐时，我把「防油纸」摊开，当盘子用。

collocations: line a tray with greaseproof paper

words.enDefinition: tools such as large spoons or tongs used to serve food

examples.en: The caterer dropped off serving utensils with the trays for our student society dinner.
examples.zh: 餐饮店把「分餐用具」和我们社团聚餐用的几盘菜一起送了过来。

examples.en: I asked for serving utensils because we were sharing dishes around one big table.
examples.zh: 大家要围着一张大桌子分着吃菜，所以我要了「分餐用具」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the restaurant is making your food

examples.en: The app still displayed 'Preparing your order' when my study group finished for the evening.
examples.zh: 学习小组晚上结束时，应用上仍显示「正在制作你的餐点」。

examples.en: I saw 'Preparing your order' on the screen and waited for a driver to be assigned.
examples.zh: 我在屏幕上看到「正在制作你的餐点」，就等着分配配送员。

collocations: a message saying preparing your order

words.enDefinition: a status showing someone has been chosen to deliver the order

examples.en: The app showed 'Courier assigned' just as I was leaving campus with my flatmate.
examples.zh: 我刚和室友离开学校，应用就显示「已分配配送员」。

examples.en: I checked the map after 'Courier assigned' appeared on the screen for our lunch.
examples.zh: 我们点的午餐在屏幕上显示「已分配配送员」后，我查看了地图。

words.expression: the courier is at the restaurant
words.lemma: the courier is at the restaurant
words.enDefinition: says the driver or rider has reached the restaurant
acceptedEnVariants: the courier is at the restaurant

examples.en: The courier is at the restaurant now, so we can start setting the table.
examples.zh: 「配送员已到餐厅」，我们可以开始摆餐具了。

examples.en: The app says the courier is at the restaurant waiting for the noodles to be packed.
examples.zh: 应用显示「配送员已到餐厅」，在等面条打包好。

collocations: the courier is at the restaurant now
the map shows the courier is at the restaurant
the courier is at the restaurant waiting for our food

words.expression: the driver has picked up your order
words.lemma: the driver has picked up your order
words.enDefinition: says the driver has collected your food from the restaurant
acceptedEnVariants: the driver has picked up your order

examples.en: The driver has picked up your order, so please keep an eye on your phone.
examples.zh: 「配送员已取餐」，请留意你的手机。

examples.en: The driver has picked up your order and is heading towards the campus residence.
examples.zh: 「配送员已取餐」，正往学校宿舍方向走。

collocations: the driver has picked up your order already
the driver has picked up your order from the café
a message saying the driver has picked up your order

words.expression: I'm on my way with your order
words.lemma: i'm on my way with your order
words.enDefinition: says the courier has the order and is bringing it to you
acceptedEnVariants: I'm on my way with your order

examples.en: I'm on my way with your order and should reach your building in five minutes.
examples.zh: 「我正带着你的餐过去」，大概五分钟就能到你那栋楼。

examples.en: Hi, I'm on my way with your order, but the main gate looks closed.
examples.zh: 你好，「我正带着你的餐过去」，不过正门看起来关着。

collocations: I'm on my way with your order now
I'm on my way with your order from the café
hi, I'm on my way with your order

words.enDefinition: says the delivery worker is close to your location

examples.en: The driver is nearby, so I'll go down to the student centre entrance now.
examples.zh: 「配送员就在附近」，我现在下楼去学生中心入口。

examples.en: The app says the driver is nearby, but I don't see anyone outside yet.
examples.zh: 应用上显示「配送员就在附近」，不过我还没看到外面有人。

collocations: the app says the driver is nearby

words.expression: track the driver on the map
words.lemma: track the driver on the map
words.zhGloss: 在地图上看配送员的位置
words.enDefinition: use a map to follow a driver's location during delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 在地图上看配送员的位置
acceptedEnVariants: track the driver on the map

examples.en: I could track the driver on the map while we cleared space for the food.
examples.zh: 我们腾出地方放吃的时，我可以「在地图上看配送员的位置」。

examples.en: You can track the driver on the map to see which gate they're approaching.
examples.zh: 可以「在地图上看配送员的位置」，看看对方快到哪个门了。

collocations: you can track the driver on the map
use the app to track the driver on the map
keep trying to track the driver on the map

words.enDefinition: says you cannot locate the building at the address given

examples.en: I can't find your building from the bike path shown on my map.
examples.zh: 按我地图上的自行车道走，「我找不到你那栋楼」。

examples.en: Sorry, I can't find your building, but I can see the main library entrance.
examples.zh: 不好意思，「我找不到你那栋楼」，不过我能看到图书馆正门。

collocations: sorry, I can't find your building
I can't find your building from the side road
I can't find your building on this map

words.enDefinition: says you are waiting outside the building at the delivery address

examples.en: I'm outside your building now, just beside the path that leads to the library.
examples.zh: 「我在你那栋楼外面」，就在通往图书馆的小路旁。

examples.en: I'm outside your building with the food, but the front door is locked.
examples.zh: 「我在你那栋楼外面」，餐也带来了，不过正门锁着。

collocations: I'm outside your building by the front door
just to let you know, I'm outside your building

words.enDefinition: asks which entrance leads to the correct delivery location

examples.en: Which entrance should I use if the main doors are locked after six?
examples.zh: 如果六点后正门锁了，「我该从哪个入口进」？

examples.en: I can see two sets of doors, so which entrance should I use?
examples.zh: 我能看到两处门，「我该从哪个入口进」？

collocations: which entrance should I use after six?
which entrance should I use for the delivery?
just checking, which entrance should I use?

words.enDefinition: asks somebody to meet you at the entrance to a building

examples.en: Could you meet me at the entrance so I can hand you the food?
examples.zh: 能「到入口来和我碰面」吗？我把餐递给你。

examples.en: Please meet me at the entrance next to the bike racks after you arrive.
examples.zh: 你到了以后，「请到自行车架旁边的入口来和我碰面」。

collocations: could you meet me at the entrance?
please meet me at the entrance
ask them to meet me at the entrance

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to put the order outside your door

examples.en: Could you leave it at my door while I'm finishing an online seminar upstairs?
examples.zh: 我在楼上快上完线上研讨课了，能「把餐放我门口」吗？

examples.en: Please leave it at my door and send me a message once you're downstairs.
examples.zh: 「请把餐放我门口」，等你下楼后给我发个消息。

collocations: please leave it at my door
could you leave it at my door?
ask the courier to leave it at my door

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to give the order to staff at reception

examples.en: Please leave it with reception because I'm running late at the library this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午在图书馆耽误了，「请把餐交给前台」。

examples.en: Could you leave it with reception so my flatmate can pick it up later?
examples.zh: 能「把餐交给前台」吗？我室友一会儿可以去拿。

collocations: could you leave it with reception?
ask the courier to leave it with reception

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to give you the order in person

examples.en: Could you hand it to me by the main entrance when you get here?
examples.zh: 你到了以后，能在正门「把餐当面交给我」吗？

examples.en: Please hand it to me because the building has nowhere sheltered to leave the bag.
examples.zh: 这栋楼没有遮雨的地方可以放袋子，「请把餐当面交给我」。

collocations: could you hand it to me at the entrance?
ask the courier to hand it to me

words.enDefinition: a delivery in which the order is left for the customer to collect

examples.en: I selected contactless delivery and asked for the bag to be left by the porch.
examples.zh: 我选择了「无接触送餐」，请对方把袋子放在门廊旁边。

examples.en: The restaurant offers contactless delivery, so I left a note about where to put the order.
examples.zh: 餐厅提供「无接触送餐」，所以我备注了餐要放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a picture showing where the courier left an order

examples.en: I checked the delivery photo to see which entrance the courier had left our food at.
examples.zh: 我查看了「送达现场照片」，想知道配送员把餐放在哪个入口。

examples.en: The delivery photo showed our dinner beside the plant in the shared hallway.
examples.zh: 「送达现场照片」显示我们的晚餐放在共用走廊那盆植物旁边。

words.enDefinition: a short code used to confirm a food delivery handover

examples.en: The courier asked for the delivery PIN when I collected the bag from him.
examples.zh: 我从配送员手里接过袋子时，他问我要「送餐确认码」。

examples.en: I opened the order screen to find the delivery PIN before walking downstairs.
examples.zh: 我打开订单页面找到「送餐确认码」，然后走下楼。

words.enDefinition: directions telling the courier where or how to leave an order

examples.en: I added drop-off instructions explaining that our building door is behind the library.
examples.zh: 我加了条「送餐交接说明」，告诉配送员我们楼的门在图书馆后面。

examples.en: The courier read the drop-off instructions and left the bag under the porch light.
examples.zh: 配送员看了「送餐交接说明」，把袋子放在门廊灯下面。

words.enDefinition: asks for a text once the courier arrives

examples.en: Please text me when you're here because the doorbell in our building doesn't work.
examples.zh: 我们楼的门铃坏了，「到这儿了请给我发消息」。

examples.en: Text me when you're here and I'll open the side door near the stairs.
examples.zh: 「到这儿了给我发消息」，我去开楼梯旁边的侧门。

collocations: please text me when you're here
text me when you're here with the food
text me when you're here at the gate

words.enDefinition: asks the courier to avoid using the doorbell

examples.en: Please don't ring the bell because my flatmate is recording an oral assignment upstairs.
examples.zh: 室友正在楼上录口语作业，「请别按门铃」。

examples.en: Please don't ring the bell when you arrive, as everyone else is already asleep.
examples.zh: 你到了以后「请别按门铃」，其他人已经睡了。

collocations: please don't ring the bell tonight
please don't ring the bell when you arrive
a note saying please don't ring the bell

words.expression: I'll come down to get it
words.lemma: i'll come down to get it
words.enDefinition: says you will go downstairs to collect the food
acceptedEnVariants: I'll come down to get it

examples.en: I'll come down to get it as soon as my online lecture finishes.
examples.zh: 线上课一结束，「我就会下楼来取餐」。

examples.en: I'll come down to get it when you reach the entrance near the bike racks.
examples.zh: 你到了自行车架旁边的入口时，「我会下楼来取餐」。

collocations: I'll come down to get it now
I'll come down to get it from reception
wait there and I'll come down to get it

words.enDefinition: says the speaker's vehicle is parked just outside the building

examples.en: I'm parked outside by the main gate because the courtyard doesn't allow cars inside.
examples.zh: 「我把车停在正门外面了」，因为院子里不让车进去。

examples.en: I'm parked outside near the library steps with two bags from the noodle shop.
examples.zh: 「我把车停在外面了」，就在图书馆台阶附近，带着面馆的两袋餐。

collocations: I'm parked outside by the main gate
I'm parked outside near the entrance

words.expression: the map pin is in the wrong place
words.lemma: the map pin is in the wrong place
words.enDefinition: reports that a location marker shows the wrong place
acceptedEnVariants: the map pin is in the wrong place

examples.en: I think the map pin is in the wrong place because I'm outside the gym.
examples.zh: 我现在在健身房外，所以我觉得「地图标记位置有误」。

examples.en: The map pin is in the wrong place, so please come to the north gate.
examples.zh: 「地图标记位置有误」，请到北门。

collocations: the map pin is in the wrong place on this app
it looks like the map pin is in the wrong place
if the map pin is in the wrong place

words.expression: can you send me a pin
words.lemma: can you send me a pin
words.zhGloss: 你能发个地图定位给我吗
words.enDefinition: asks somebody to share a marked location on a map
acceptedZhAnswers: 你能发个地图定位给我吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you send me a pin

examples.en: Can you send me a pin for the entrance so I can find your building?
examples.zh: 「你能发个入口的地图定位给我吗」？我好找到你那栋楼。

examples.en: Can you send me a pin in the chat while I wait by the road?
examples.zh: 我在路边等着，「你能在聊天里发个地图定位给我吗」？

collocations: can you send me a pin for the entrance?
can you send me a pin in the chat?
if possible, can you send me a pin?

words.enDefinition: asks somebody to go in through the door at the side

examples.en: Please use the side entrance so you can avoid the queue at the front.
examples.zh: 「请走侧门」，这样能避开正门排队的人。

examples.en: I asked the courier to use the side entrance because the front steps were blocked.
examples.zh: 正门的台阶被挡住了，我请配送员「走侧门」。

collocations: use the side entrance after dark
ask them to use the side entrance

words.expression: the door is around the corner
words.lemma: the door is around the corner
words.enDefinition: says the door is just beyond the nearest corner
acceptedEnVariants: the door is around the corner

examples.en: The door is around the corner on the left, just past the bike racks.
examples.zh: 「那扇门在左边拐角过去」，过了自行车架就是。

examples.en: The door is around the corner from the café with the blue sign outside.
examples.zh: 「那扇门从咖啡馆拐过去就到」，那家咖啡馆外面有块蓝牌子。

collocations: the door is around the corner on the left
the door is around the corner from the sign
the door is around the corner by the stairs

words.enDefinition: asks someone to make the call using the app's phone feature

examples.en: Please call me through the app when you arrive at the sports centre entrance.
examples.zh: 你到了体育中心入口后，「请通过应用给我打电话」。

examples.en: You can call me through the app if the residence gate is closed tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚宿舍大门如果关了，你可以「通过应用给我打电话」。

collocations: please call me through the app
you can call me through the app
call me through the app if you get lost

words.expression: your order is taking longer than expected
words.lemma: your order is taking longer than expected
words.enDefinition: notifies someone that their food order is delayed
acceptedEnVariants: your order is taking longer than expected

examples.en: Sorry, your order is taking longer than expected because we're making the sandwiches again.
examples.zh: 不好意思，「你的订单比预计的慢」，因为我们正在重做三明治。

examples.en: Your order is taking longer than expected, but the courier is already at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 「你的订单比预计的慢」，不过配送员已经到餐厅了。

collocations: notify you that your order is taking longer than expected
a message saying your order is taking longer than expected
sorry, your order is taking longer than expected

words.enDefinition: a prompt asking for a room number to complete the delivery address

examples.en: The checkout screen said 'Room number required' when I entered the residence address for lunch.
examples.zh: 我点午饭填宿舍地址时，结账页面提示「需要填写房间号」。

examples.en: I saw 'Room number required,' so I asked whether delivery to reception was possible.
examples.zh: 我看到提示「需要填写房间号」，就问能不能送到前台。

words.enDefinition: says that traffic is delaying you on the way

examples.en: Sorry, traffic is holding me up near the bridge, but I have your food.
examples.zh: 不好意思，「桥附近堵车耽误了我」，餐已经在我这儿了。

examples.en: Traffic is holding me up this evening, so the delivery might be a little late.
examples.zh: 今晚「路上堵车耽误了我」，餐可能会送晚一点。

collocations: sorry, traffic is holding me up
traffic is holding me up near the bridge
traffic is holding me up today

words.expression: I'll wait by the main gate
words.lemma: i'll wait by the main gate
words.enDefinition: says you will wait for someone at the main gate
acceptedEnVariants: I'll wait by the main gate

examples.en: I'll wait by the main gate with my phone while you approach the residence.
examples.zh: 你往宿舍走的时候，「我会拿着手机在正门旁等」。

examples.en: I'll wait by the main gate because the entrance near the library is closed.
examples.zh: 图书馆旁的入口关了，「我会在正门旁等」。

collocations: I'll wait by the main gate after class
I'll wait by the main gate with my phone
if it's easier, I'll wait by the main gate

words.enDefinition: says that the courier needs to make another delivery stop

examples.en: The app says the driver has another stop before coming to our campus entrance.
examples.zh: 应用上说「配送员还要先停一站」，然后才到咱们学校入口。

examples.en: The driver has another stop, so I'll turn my ringer back on and keep studying.
examples.zh: 「配送员还要先停一站」，所以我会把手机铃声重新打开，然后继续学习。

collocations: the app says the driver has another stop
the driver has another stop before ours
if the driver has another stop

words.enDefinition: reports that the food container was badly squeezed or dented

examples.en: The box got crushed under the drinks that were packed in the same bag.
examples.zh: 饮料装在同一个袋子里，把「餐盒压扁了」。

examples.en: It looks like the box got crushed before the courier reached our residence hall.
examples.zh: 好像配送员还没到宿舍楼，「餐盒就被压扁了」。

collocations: the box got crushed in the bag
the box got crushed on the way
it looks like the box got crushed

words.enDefinition: says the food delivered was meant for a different customer

examples.en: I got someone else's order, and the name on the receipt isn't mine.
examples.zh: 「我收到了别人的餐」，小票上的名字也不是我的。

examples.en: I got someone else's order when two bags were left by the residence entrance.
examples.zh: 宿舍入口放了两袋餐，「我收到了别人的餐」。

collocations: I got someone else's order by mistake
it looks like I got someone else's order
I got someone else's order from the same restaurant

words.enDefinition: says changes to the food order did not reach the restaurant

examples.en: It looks like my changes didn't come through because the kitchen saw the old order.
examples.zh: 后厨看到的是旧订单，看来「我的改动没传到餐厅」。

examples.en: My changes didn't come through after the app briefly lost its connection to the restaurant.
examples.zh: 应用和餐厅短暂断开连接后，「我的改动没传到餐厅」。

collocations: it looks like my changes didn't come through
my changes didn't come through this time
tell the restaurant my changes didn't come through

words.zhGloss: 标为已送达但还没收到
words.enDefinition: says the app shows delivery completed although the food is missing
acceptedZhAnswers: 标为已送达但还没收到

examples.en: My dinner is marked delivered but hasn't arrived at the residence desk or door.
examples.zh: 我的晚餐「标为已送达但还没收到」，宿舍前台和门口都没有。

examples.en: It's marked delivered but hasn't arrived, and the driver hasn't sent me a photo.
examples.zh: 「标为已送达但还没收到」，配送员也没给我发照片。

collocations: my order is marked delivered but hasn't arrived
report that it is marked delivered but hasn't arrived
the food is marked delivered but hasn't arrived

words.enDefinition: says a container's cover fell or moved off it

examples.en: The lid came off the coffee cup while I was walking back to campus.
examples.zh: 走回学校的路上，咖啡杯的「盖子掉了」。

examples.en: The lid came off in the bag, so I contacted the café after lunch.
examples.zh: 「杯盖在袋子里掉了」，我午饭后联系了咖啡馆。

collocations: the lid came off in the bag
the lid came off during the ride
it looks like the lid came off

words.expression: the food spilled in the bag
words.lemma: the food spilled in the bag
words.enDefinition: says some food escaped its container inside the bag
acceptedEnVariants: the food spilled in the bag

examples.en: The food spilled in the bag before I could take it into the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及把餐拿进厨房，「餐就洒在袋子里了」。

examples.en: The food spilled in the bag, so we asked if the café could replace it.
examples.zh: 「餐洒在袋子里了」，所以我们问咖啡馆能不能重新给我们做一份。

collocations: the food spilled in the bag on the way
it looks like the food spilled in the bag
report that the food spilled in the bag

words.enDefinition: reports that a hot meal was cold when it arrived

examples.en: The food arrived cold after the courier went to the wrong residence building first.
examples.zh: 配送员先去了另一栋宿舍，「餐送到时已经凉了」。

examples.en: The food arrived cold even though the café is only a short walk away.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆走几步就到，「餐送到时还是已经凉了」。

collocations: the food arrived cold after the delay
tell them the food arrived cold
the food arrived cold this time

words.enDefinition: says the order was left at another door

examples.en: My order was delivered to the wrong door, according to the photo in the app.
examples.zh: 从应用里的照片来看，我的餐「送错门了」。

examples.en: The courier realized it had been delivered to the wrong door after I called.
examples.zh: 我打电话以后，配送员才意识到那袋餐「送错门了」。

collocations: an order delivered to the wrong door
report an order delivered to the wrong door
a bag delivered to the wrong door

words.enDefinition: says the food bag was not closed when received

examples.en: The bag was open when I got it, and one of the containers was upside down.
examples.zh: 我拿到时「外卖袋是开着的」，里面有一个餐盒是倒扣着的。

examples.en: The bag was open at the top, so I checked that both sandwiches were inside.
examples.zh: 「外卖袋的袋口是开着的」，所以我看了看两份三明治是否都在。

collocations: the bag was open when I got it
the bag was open at the top
tell them the bag was open

words.enDefinition: prepare the customer's food again after a problem

examples.en: Could you remake my order because this pizza has a completely different topping on it?
examples.zh: 能「重做我点的餐」吗？这张披萨上的配料完全不一样。

examples.en: The kitchen agreed to remake my order once I showed them the receipt from the app.
examples.zh: 我给后厨看了应用里的小票，他们同意「重做我点的餐」。

collocations: ask the kitchen to remake my order
can you remake my order tonight?

words.enDefinition: deliver the item that was left out of an order

examples.en: Could you send out the missing item if the driver is still near campus?
examples.zh: 如果配送员还在学校附近，能「把漏掉的餐品补送来」吗？

examples.en: The café offered to send out the missing item with another delivery going past our residence.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆提出等另一单经过我们的宿舍时，「把漏掉的餐品补送来」。

collocations: could you send out the missing item?
ask the restaurant to send out the missing item
offer to send out the missing item

words.expression: can you refund the missing item
words.lemma: can you refund the missing item
words.zhGloss: 能退还漏送餐品的钱吗
words.enDefinition: asks for a refund covering the food that was not delivered
acceptedZhAnswers: 能退还漏送餐品的钱吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you refund the missing item

examples.en: Can you refund the missing item since I need to leave for class shortly?
examples.zh: 我一会儿要去上课，「能退还漏送餐品的钱吗」？

examples.en: Can you refund the missing item from tonight's order for our study group dinner?
examples.zh: 我们学习小组今晚下的那单，「能退还漏送餐品的钱吗」？

collocations: can you refund the missing item from my order?
can you refund the missing item instead?
if that's easier, can you refund the missing item?

words.enDefinition: a balance available for future orders through a food delivery service

examples.en: The app offered food delivery credit that I could use on a future order.
examples.zh: 应用给了「外卖平台抵扣余额」，我可以在以后下单时用。

examples.en: I checked whether the food delivery credit would cover part of my next dinner order.
examples.zh: 我查了「外卖平台抵扣余额」能不能抵扣下次点晚饭的一部分费用。

collocations: apply food delivery credit to an order

words.expression: report a problem with my order
words.lemma: report a problem with my order
words.enDefinition: tell the restaurant or delivery service something went wrong
acceptedEnVariants: report a problem with my order

examples.en: I need to report a problem with my order because the drink arrived without a lid.
examples.zh: 我需要「报告餐品订单的问题」，送到的饮料没盖子。

examples.en: I called to report a problem with my order after noticing the missing fries.
examples.zh: 我发现少了薯条，就打电话「报告餐品订单的问题」。

collocations: need to report a problem with my order
where to report a problem with my order
call to report a problem with my order

words.enDefinition: a message service for help without leaving the app

examples.en: I opened the in-app support chat after receiving only one of the two lunch boxes.
examples.zh: 两份盒装午餐只收到一份，我就打开了「应用内客服聊天」。

examples.en: The in-app support chat asked which restaurant had prepared the order we received.
examples.zh: 「应用内客服聊天」里问我们收到的餐是哪家餐厅做的。

collocations: contact someone through the in-app support chat

words.enDefinition: a picture showing the items actually delivered to the customer

examples.en: I attached a photo of what arrived so support could see which pizza we received.
examples.zh: 我附上了「实收餐品照片」，方便客服看到我们收到的是哪款披萨。

examples.en: The app asked for a photo of what arrived before I could submit my report.
examples.zh: 提交问题报告之前，应用要求上传「实收餐品照片」。

collocations: take a photo of what arrived
send a photo of what arrived
attach a photo of what arrived

words.enDefinition: says the listed collection time has been changed repeatedly

examples.en: The pickup time keeps changing, and I need to return to class in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 「取餐时间一直在变」，我十分钟后得回去上课。

examples.en: The pickup time keeps changing because the kitchen is finishing a large group order.
examples.zh: 后厨正在做完一个大团餐单，所以「取餐时间一直在变」。

collocations: the pickup time keeps changing in the app
the pickup time keeps changing again
tell them the pickup time keeps changing

words.expression: the restaurant hasn't got my order
words.lemma: the restaurant hasn't got my order
words.enDefinition: says the restaurant does not have the order you submitted
acceptedEnVariants: the restaurant hasn't got my order
the restaurant hasn't received my order

examples.en: The restaurant hasn't got my order, so I checked whether I'd selected another branch.
examples.zh: 「餐厅还没收到我的单」，于是我看看是不是选了另一家分店。

examples.en: It looks like the restaurant hasn't got my order even though the app accepted it.
examples.zh: 应用接受了订单，但看起来「餐厅还没收到我的单」。

collocations: it looks like the restaurant hasn't got my order
the restaurant hasn't got my order yet
if the restaurant hasn't got my order

words.expression: can the restaurant still change my order
words.lemma: can the restaurant still change my order
words.zhGloss: 餐厅还能改我的订单吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether the food order can still be altered
acceptedZhAnswers: 餐厅还能改我的订单吗
acceptedEnVariants: can the restaurant still change my order

examples.en: Can the restaurant still change my order if the sandwiches haven't been made yet?
examples.zh: 如果三明治还没做，「餐厅还能改我的订单吗」？

examples.en: Can the restaurant still change my order to two bowls of soup instead of one?
examples.zh: 「餐厅还能改我的订单吗」？我想把一碗汤改成两碗。

collocations: can the restaurant still change my order now?
can the restaurant still change my order before the driver gets it?
if it's early enough, can the restaurant still change my order?

words.expression: can I switch from delivery to pickup
words.lemma: can i switch from delivery to pickup
words.zhGloss: 我能把外送改成自提吗
words.enDefinition: asks to collect a food order originally booked for delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 我能把外送改成自提吗
acceptedEnVariants: can I switch from delivery to pickup

examples.en: Can I switch from delivery to pickup now that I'm near the café anyway?
examples.zh: 既然我已经在咖啡馆附近，「我能把外送改成自提吗」？

examples.en: Can I switch from delivery to pickup if the driver hasn't collected the food?
examples.zh: 如果配送员还没取餐，「我能把外送改成自提吗」？

collocations: can I switch from delivery to pickup today?
can I switch from delivery to pickup before it's ready?
since I'm nearby, can I switch from delivery to pickup?

words.expression: can I cancel before they start cooking
words.lemma: can i cancel before they start cooking
words.zhGloss: 还没开始做餐能取消吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether cancellation is possible before food preparation starts
acceptedZhAnswers: 还没开始做餐能取消吗
acceptedEnVariants: can I cancel before they start cooking

examples.en: Can I cancel before they start cooking because I accidentally ordered from another branch?
examples.zh: 我误选了另一家分店，「还没开始做餐能取消吗」？

examples.en: Can I cancel before they start cooking if my flatmate has already bought dinner?
examples.zh: 如果我室友已经买了晚饭，「还没开始做餐能取消吗」？

collocations: can I cancel before they start cooking my food?
can I cancel before they start cooking the new order?
since I ordered twice, can I cancel before they start cooking?

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for ordering below a stated amount

examples.en: The app added a small order fee because I was only ordering one sandwich.
examples.zh: 我只点一份三明治，应用加收了「小额订单附加费」。

examples.en: We shared an order to avoid the small order fee on two separate meals.
examples.zh: 我们合在一个单里点餐，省下分两单的「小额订单附加费」。

words.enDefinition: a platform charge for arranging a restaurant order

examples.en: I noticed the service fee on our pizza order after checking the final total.
examples.zh: 我核对最终总价时，注意到披萨订单里有「外卖平台服务费」。

examples.en: The app listed the service fee separately from the cost of sending the courier.
examples.zh: 应用把「外卖平台服务费」和配送员送餐的费用分开列。

words.enDefinition: an extra delivery charge added when a service is especially busy

examples.en: The app showed a peak-time delivery surcharge while everyone was ordering dinner after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后大家都在点晚饭，应用显示有「高峰时段送餐附加费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the peak-time delivery surcharge applied before ordering food for the study group.
examples.zh: 给学习小组点餐前，我查了是否要收「高峰时段送餐附加费」。

words.enDefinition: a paid option offered to give an order higher delivery priority

examples.en: The app offered priority delivery, but I had time to wait after my lecture.
examples.zh: 应用提供「优先送餐」，不过我下课后有时间等。

examples.en: We considered priority delivery because rehearsal was starting again sooner than we thought.
examples.zh: 排练比我们想的更快就要继续，我们考虑选「优先送餐」。

words.enDefinition: a pass or subscription offering benefits on food deliveries

examples.en: I checked what the delivery pass covered before deciding how often to order through the app.
examples.zh: 我查了「送餐优惠会员」包含哪些优惠，再决定多久在应用上点一次。

examples.en: The delivery pass gave me a lower charge for ordering lunch from that café.
examples.zh: 用了「送餐优惠会员」，我向那家咖啡馆点午饭时费用低了一些。

words.enDefinition: a price reduction for collecting the food yourself

examples.en: The café offered a pickup discount, so I walked over with my roommate after class.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有「自提折扣」，所以下课后我和室友走过去拿餐。

examples.en: I asked whether the pickup discount applied to the meal we ordered by phone.
examples.zh: 我问用电话点的这份餐能不能享受「自提折扣」。

words.enDefinition: extra money a customer chooses to give to the courier

examples.en: I added a driver tip after the courier brought dinner to the correct residence entrance.
examples.zh: 配送员把晚饭送到了正确的宿舍入口，我加了「给配送员的小费」。

examples.en: The app listed my driver tip separately from the other charges for lunch.
examples.zh: 应用把午餐订单里「给配送员的小费」和其他费用分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a charge for the containers or bags used for takeaway food

examples.en: The café listed a packaging charge beside the price of my two takeaway soups.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在我那两份外带汤的价格旁边列出了「餐品打包费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the packaging charge applied when I collected the order myself.
examples.zh: 我问自己去取餐时，是否也要付「餐品打包费」。

words.enDefinition: an increase over the price on the restaurant's own menu

examples.en: I noticed a menu markup when I compared the app with the café's own menu.
examples.zh: 我把应用和咖啡馆自己的菜单一比，发现有「平台餐品加价」。

examples.en: The shop said there was no menu markup on the two lunch deals that week.
examples.zh: 店家说那一周的两个午餐套餐都没有「平台餐品加价」。

collocations: a menu markup on delivery orders

words.expression: could you check inside the bag
words.lemma: could you check inside the bag
words.zhGloss: 能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗
words.enDefinition: asks someone to check what the food bag contains
acceptedZhAnswers: 能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗
acceptedEnVariants: could you check inside the bag

examples.en: Could you check inside the bag to make sure both sandwiches are in there?
examples.zh: 「能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗」？我想确认两份三明治都装进去了。

examples.en: Could you check inside the bag for the sauce we ordered with the dumplings?
examples.zh: 「能帮我检查一下袋子里面吗」？我们点了饺子配的酱料。

collocations: could you check inside the bag for the drinks?
could you check inside the bag before I leave?
before you seal it, could you check inside the bag?

words.enDefinition: asks the restaurant to keep prepared food warm until collection

examples.en: Can you keep it warm until I get there after my last lecture ends?
examples.zh: 「能先帮我把餐保温吗」？我最后一节课上完就过去。

examples.en: Can you keep it warm while my flatmate walks over from the student centre?
examples.zh: 我室友正从学生中心走过去，「能先帮我把餐保温吗」？

collocations: can you keep it warm until I get there?
can you keep it warm for pickup?
while I walk over, can you keep it warm?
